description: Land Title Settlement Department - Opanayaka, Opanayaka D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620676 (23/0830)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determination of land titles for multiple parcels of land in Opanayaka. It involves the Registration of Title Act, cadastral maps, land parcel numbers, and ownership determinations (all showing "The State" as owner). The content falls under land registrations and property ownership matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
